channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Hakeem Olajuwon | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Hakeem Olajuwon from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Hakeem Olajuwon, Wilt Chamberlain
item.description:
Karl-Anthony Towns:

“I think Hakeem. And I feel like in a way he kind of is like mythical like Wilt Chamberlain. Like, you know, but we have something to watch Hakeem games on, but like it's kind of like that same mythical creature like Wilt, but I've been able to talk and meet Hakeem and he's an amazing human. So I'm very honored to say that.”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Hakeem Olajuwon, Wilt Chamberlain, Oct 17, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Cedric Maxwell on Hakeem Olajuwon
item.description:
Cedric Maxwell:

“I say the best player I ever played with wasn't Larry. But I played my last year, I played with Hakeem Olajuwon. I think Hakeem Olajuwon was maybe the greatest player of all-time that nobody talks about,because he dominated the floor better than anybody on both ends as ever. Larry was so cold-blooded, man. He would always talk to guys and say, 'Is your coach mad at you?' I'm like, 'Why?' He said, 'Because you have to guard me.' He would tell the coach, 'You must be kidding me.' If you put this white guy on me, I'm embarrassed that you put a white guy to guard me. Larry just had some stuff about him that was a little unusual, a little hickish, but man, what a great player he was.”

Cedric Maxwell on Hakeem Olajuwon, Jun 17, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Victor Wembanyama on Hakeem Olajuwon
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Wemby on meeting Hakeem:

“We met at the finals of NCAA. Right away he was very friendly and he told me right away that he wanted to share what he had what he knew. All the footwork stuff things that look easy but aren't but he makes them easier”

Victor Wembanyama on Hakeem Olajuwon, Apr 16, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kyrie Irving on Tim Duncan, Hakeem Olajuwon
item.description:
Kyrie Irving:

“I'll give you another name, right? That we're not going to allow people to revise history: Hakeem Olajuwon. Salams to my big brother, man. Salams to Hakeem. We're not going to let people pretend like Hakeem was not that. Before there was a Tim Duncan, there was a Hakeem Olajuwon.”

Kyrie Irving on Tim Duncan, Hakeem Olajuwon, Jul 23, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Toni Kukoc on Hakeem Olajuwon
item.description:
“To me, [Hakeem] is the BEST center of all time… He shows you all these moves. He shows pretty much EVERY fundamental of basketball imaginable.”

Toni Kukoc on Hakeem Olajuwon, May 6, 2025. Source: ScoopB.com.

item.title: Rick Barry on Hakeem Olajuwon
item.description:
“I talked to all the athletes about trying to get outside. I’ve been trying to get Hakeem Olajuwon to start.”

Rick Barry on Hakeem Olajuwon, Oct 17, 2024. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Sam Cassell on Hakeem Olajuwon, Joel Embiid, Nikola Jokic
item.description:
Sam Cassell believes that Nikola Jokić wouldn’t be able to stop Hakeem Olajuwon.

“On the other end of the floor, Jokić wouldn’t stand a chance. Joel Embiid gives him problems, and he wouldn’t have any hope against Hakeem. I believe Hakeem would have an answer for whatever Jokić tried defensively,”

Sam Cassell on Hakeem Olajuwon, Joel Embiid, Nikola Jokic, Aug 17, 2024. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Hakeem Olajuwon
item.description:
Three hoops greats made the cut on Friday’s episode of Dubs Talk with Monte Poole and Dalton Johnson of NBC Sports Bay Area, which included an interview with the future Hall of Famer.

“My top three, I’d probably say [Michael] Jordan, Shaq [Shaquille O’Neal] and maybe Hakeem Olajuwon,”

Stephen Curry on Hakeem Olajuwon, Nov 17, 2023. Source: KXAN Austin.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Hakeem Olajuwon
item.description:
“My mom used to have a crush on Olajuwon when I was a kid... It wasn't Jordan it was Olajuwon in the house.”

Kevin Durant on Hakeem Olajuwon, Oct 27, 2023. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Kelvin Sampson on Gilbert Arenas, Hakeem Olajuwon
item.description:
“Gilbert, I respect his game to whatever degree, but when you try to compare that to ‘The Dream,' Hakeem Olajuwon, big man back in the day, the skill-set and the footwork that Hakeem had, [Arenas] needs to go back and look at some more film because I don't think he really knows what the hell he’s talking about,”

Kelvin Sampson on Gilbert Arenas, Hakeem Olajuwon, Sep 22, 2023. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Dereck Lively on Hakeem Olajuwon, Anthony Davis, Willie Cauley-Stein
item.description:
When asked who he’d compare himself to at the NBA level, Lively gave a diverse list of players.

“I’d definitely say Willie Cauley-Stein,and you’ve got aspects of Anthony Davis’ game and Hakeem Olajuwon’s game,”

Dereck Lively on Hakeem Olajuwon, Anthony Davis, Willie Cauley-Stein, May 28, 2023. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Stephen Silas on Clyde Drexler, Hakeem Olajuwon, Calvin Murphy, Alperen Sengun
item.description:
Mark Berman:Stephen Silas on Hakeem Olajuwon working with @Alperen Sengun:

“Having Hakeem teaching you is like unbelievable. One of the great things of being a Houston Rocket you have so many people willing to help especially guys like him, Rudy T, Calvin Murphy.. Clyde Drexler.. It’s great.”

Stephen Silas on Clyde Drexler, Hakeem Olajuwon, Calvin Murphy, Alperen Sengun, Feb 6, 2022. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Alperen Sengun on Hakeem Olajuwon
item.description:
Sengun said of his footwork.

“I was watching a lot. When I watch, I learn quickly, and it also helps me a lot. But also I’d like to work with Hakeem Olajuwon about this. We will work in the future. He said, ‘I’ll teach you some moves.’ It’s good for me, I’m waiting.”

Alperen Sengun on Hakeem Olajuwon, Dec 17, 2021. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Sam Cassell on Hakeem Olajuwon
item.description:
Cassell said on Point God with Baron Davis.

“We lose by 40 to GP [Gary Payton] and Seattle [Supersonics]. I remember calling my boy and saying, man, Hakeem Olajuwon, sorry as s–t. He was 3-12 and only got 3 rebounds in 15 minutes. He got 3 rebounds, not knowing veterans didn’t take preseason serious[ly], they used the preseason to get in shape. [Because] Back then, the preseason was a full month.”

Sam Cassell on Hakeem Olajuwon, Oct 3, 2021. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Robert Horry on Hakeem Olajuwon
item.description:
Immediately, Horry makes it clear it is his personal opinion and says because of his belief he is public enemy No. 1 in San Antonio.

“First of all, it’s just my opinion and I thought at the time that Dream [Olajuwon] was better than Tim and people get mad at me for saying that,”

Robert Horry on Hakeem Olajuwon, Aug 27, 2021. Source: Kens5.com.

item.title: Robert Horry on Hakeem Olajuwon
item.description:
“You got to understand I grew up an Olajuwon fan. I watched him. I played with him. I played with Tim. Tim was a hell of a player,”

Robert Horry on Hakeem Olajuwon, Aug 27, 2021. Source: Kens5.com.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Hakeem Olajuwon, Joel Embiid
item.description:
Chase Hughes:Scott Brooks on Joel Embiid:

“I was fortunate enough to play with [Hakeem] Olajuwon for three years. He's doing things that I haven't seen since then.”

Scott Brooks on Hakeem Olajuwon, Joel Embiid, May 30, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChaseHughesNBCS.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Hakeem Olajuwon
item.description:
Brooks joked when asked about it today,

“It’s gonna be tough to fill. There’s been a lot of great tandems in this league’s history. Magic and (Abdul)-Jabbar. Shaq and Kobe. Olajuwon and Brooks.”

Scott Brooks on Hakeem Olajuwon, Dec 11, 2020. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Hakeem Olajuwon
item.description:
Scott Brooks joined the Wizards Talk podcast this week and said he thinks the 1994 Rockets still would have won the title.

“[The Bulls] had no answer for [Olajuwon]. It's easy for me to say this now because it's all hypothetical, but I don't think they would have beat us in '94,”

Scott Brooks on Hakeem Olajuwon, May 28, 2020. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Grant Hill, Hakeem Olajuwon
item.description:
“My one-on-one game was similar to Grant Hill. I could handle it, put it between the legs, do a lot of tricks and all that stuff. (Olajuwon) wouldn’t have been expecting that. He wouldn't have been ready for that. I wanted to be able to showcase a different game.”

Shaquille O'Neal on Grant Hill, Hakeem Olajuwon, May 15, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Rod Thorn on Michael Jordan, Hakeem Olajuwon
item.description:
“We had decided quite a bit before the draft that if Jordan were there, we'd take Jordan. If [Hakeem] Olajuwon somehow got to three, we'd take Olajuwon but obviously that was not going to happen,”

Rod Thorn on Michael Jordan, Hakeem Olajuwon, Apr 22, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Rudy Tomjanovich on Hakeem Olajuwon
item.description:
“He didn’t feel that they could contain Hakeem. They just didn’t have the personnel to do it. And he said he thought we were the team that gave them the most trouble.”

Rudy Tomjanovich on Hakeem Olajuwon, Apr 13, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Rudy Tomjanovich on Hakeem Olajuwon
item.description:
Mark Berman:Rudy Tomjanovich on Hakeem Olajuwon (@Hakeem Olajuwon)agreeing to be 1 of his presenters when Rudy is inducted @Hoophall:

“It’s the right way, because he’s the reason I’m standing up there. If I don’t have Hakeem,does it happen? We don’t know,probably not. He was such a big part of my life”

Rudy Tomjanovich on Hakeem Olajuwon, Apr 11, 2020. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Calvin Murphy on Hakeem Olajuwon
item.description:
I’m sitting with Calvin Murphy at the table, and we’re talking and I said,

“Hey, Calvin, I think I’m coaching the guy that reminds me a lot of Hakeem (Olajuwon) with his feet.”

Calvin Murphy on Hakeem Olajuwon, Apr 26, 2019. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Robert Horry on Hakeem Olajuwon
item.description:
David Hardisty:Robert Horry on who he was a fan of in the NBA while growing up in Alabama:

“I became an Olajuwon fan. I had the Etonics. I used to be on the court trying to emulate him.”

Robert Horry on Hakeem Olajuwon, Oct 2, 2018. Source: Twitter @clutchfans.

item.title: Tad Boyle on Hakeem Olajuwon
item.description:
Colorado coach Tad Boyle told NBA.com:

“He’s a monster. I played (at Kansas) in the ’80s, and he’s the best player since Hakeem Olajuwon. He’s that kind of talent.”

Tad Boyle on Hakeem Olajuwon, Jun 17, 2018. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Luc Mbah a Moute on Manute Bol, Dikembe Mutombo, Hakeem Olajuwon
item.description:
“When I say they, Hakeem and Dikembe, to name those two pioneers, they are the reason why we're here. You can name Manute Bol, as well. I think all African players, we all looked up to him. They paved the way, especially him because he went to college here, him and Dikembe. They pretty much paved the way for guys like me to be here. I've always looked at him as an inspiration to pave the way with other kids, kids I've been involved with so far.”

Luc Mbah a Moute on Manute Bol, Dikembe Mutombo, Hakeem Olajuwon, Feb 12, 2018. Source: Houston Chronicle.

item.title: Kristaps Porzingis on Hakeem Olajuwon
item.description:
“Everyone can always get stronger,’’ Olajuwon said. “But he’s fantastic, always plays with confidence, has a lot of moves, shooting 3s. I think the post game is most important because of his length. He’s so skilled he can do whatever he wants on the floor.”

Kristaps Porzingis on Hakeem Olajuwon, Nov 26, 2017. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Ivica Zubac on Hakeem Olajuwon
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Ivica Zubac on learning moves on YouTube:

“Watching a lot of Hakeem Olajuwon. I was trying to include that in my game. I’m trying to learn every day.”

Ivica Zubac on Hakeem Olajuwon, Sep 26, 2016. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Hakeem Olajuwon
item.description:
Ujiri told The Vertical late Saturday night.

“So I called him into the room, and said, ‘Biz, with all due respect, I’ve had all kinds of guys go work out with Hakeem. At the end of the day, there’s only one Hakeem in the world and there will never be another one. That guy was a ballerina. I don’t care what you think you’re going to do with that guy but … no, forget it.’Go watch Tyson Chandler. Rebound. Block shots. Run. That’s your bread and butter. Listen, Biz, I don’t know if anyone’s throwing you the ball in the post.”

Masai Ujiri on Hakeem Olajuwon, May 22, 2016. Source: Yahoo! Sports.
